exercises.title: Classifying input 1 — clue words
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers suggests listening for clue words to classify what stakeholders say into nine buckets: business requirements, user requirements, business rules, functional requirements, quality attributes, external interfaces, constraints, data requirements and solution ideas.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Wiegers gợi ý nghe các từ khoá để xếp lời bên liên quan vào chín nhóm: yêu cầu nghiệp vụ, yêu cầu người dùng, business rule, yêu cầu chức năng, thuộc tính chất lượng, giao diện ngoài, ràng buộc, yêu cầu dữ liệu và ý tưởng giải pháp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

examplesJson.output: Correct / Incorrect + explanation after Submit|||Đúng / Sai + giải thích sau khi Nộp
examplesJson.explanation: Each question (or table cell) is one check.|||Mỗi câu (hoặc ô) là một kiểm.

hintsJson: Tiền, thị phần ⇒ business; "tôi cần" ⇒ user; "theo chính sách" ⇒ business rule.
Tính từ chất lượng ⇒ quality attribute; cách làm cụ thể ⇒ solution idea.

# Classifying input 1 — clue words — answer key

1. "…increase market share by 10%…", "…save $200,000 a year…" usually signal a…"…tăng thị phần 10%…", "…tiết kiệm 200.000 đô mỗi năm…" thường báo hiệu…
   Answer: c) business requirement
   Financial or market benefits = business requirements.VI: Lợi ích tài chính, thị trường = yêu cầu nghiệp vụ.

2. "I need to…", "I want to be able to…" from a user usually signal a…"Tôi cần…", "Tôi muốn có thể…" từ người dùng thường báo hiệu…
   Answer: c) user requirement
   A task or goal of the user.VI: Một việc hay mục tiêu của người dùng.

3. "…must comply with…", "…according to the policy…" usually signal a…"…phải tuân theo…", "…theo chính sách…" thường báo hiệu…
   Answer: a) business rule
   Policies and regulations exist outside the software.VI: Chính sách và quy định tồn tại ngoài phần mềm.

4. "…fast, easy, secure, reliable…" usually signal a…"…nhanh, dễ, an toàn, ổn định…" thường báo hiệu…
   Answer: a) quality attribute (to be made measurable)
   Adjectives about how well ⇒ quality attributes; the BA must quantify them.VI: Tính từ về mức độ tốt ⇒ thuộc tính chất lượng; BA phải lượng hoá.

5. "Use a drop-down list…", "Store it in a spreadsheet…" usually signal a…"Dùng danh sách thả xuống…", "Lưu vào bảng tính…" thường báo hiệu…
   Answer: c) solution idea
   A how, not a what — look for the need behind it.VI: Một cách làm, không phải điều cần — tìm nhu cầu đằng sau.

exercises.title: Classifying input 2 — notes from a library interview
exercises.problemHtml:
Notes from interviews about a new university library system. Classify each into one of the nine buckets.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Ghi chép phỏng vấn về hệ thống thư viện mới. Xếp mỗi câu vào một trong chín nhóm.

Mỗi dòng được chấm riêng; giải thích từng đáp án hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

examplesJson.output: Correct / Incorrect + explanation after Submit|||Đúng / Sai + giải thích sau khi Nộp
examplesJson.explanation: Each question (or table cell) is one check.|||Mỗi câu (hoặc ô) là một kiểm.

hintsJson: "The system tells…" ⇒ hành vi hệ thống ⇒ functional; "I need to…" ⇒ user.
Cấu trúc bản ghi ⇒ data requirement.

# Classifying input 2 — notes from a library interview — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Business requirement
   - r1.k: User requirement
   - r2.k: Business rule
   - r3.k: Functional requirement
   - r4.k: Quality attribute
   - r5.k: External interface
   - r6.k: Constraint
   - r7.k: Data requirement
   - r8.k: Solution idea
   One example per bucket. The hardest pair is functional requirement (what the system does) vs user requirement (what the user wants to do).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: One example per bucket. The hardest pair is functional requirement (what the system does) vs user requirement (what the user wants to do).

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: Director: "We want to cut the cost of manual check-out by 40% in two years."
Student: "I need to renew my loans from my phone."
Librarian: "Reference books may never be borrowed — that is the library charter."
Librarian: "When a reserved book is returned, the system tells the next reader in the queue."
IT: "Search must answer in under 2 seconds with 500 users online."
IT: "It has to read student status from the student information system through its API."
IT: "It must use the university’s Oracle licence."
Cataloguer: "A book record has ISBN, title, authors, edition and up to 5 subject codes."
Student: "Add a big red Renew all button on the home page."

bang.giaiThich: One example per bucket. The hardest pair is functional requirement (what the system does) vs user requirement (what the user wants to do).

mistakesJson.loi: Xếp "dùng bản quyền Oracle" là external interface — đó là constraint.
Xếp danh sách trường dữ liệu là functional.

# Classifying input 3 — tricky sentences — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: User requirement
   - r1.k: Business rule
   - r2.k: Solution idea
   - r3.k: Business rule / Data requirement
   - r4.k: Functional requirement
   - r5.k: Business rule
   - r6.k: Constraint
   - r7.k: Business rule
   A fine formula and who may waive a fine are policies (business rules); "should be able to pay" is a user goal; a table design is a solution idea; the timeout behaviour is functional; reusing old kiosks is a constraint. Retention periods required by audit are business rules that later produce data requirements.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A fine formula and who may waive a fine are policies (business rules); "should be able to pay" is a user goal; a table design is a solution idea; the timeout behaviour is functional; reusing old kiosks is a constraint. Retention periods required by audit are business rules that later produce data requirements.

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: "Students should be able to pay fines with the e-wallet." (student)
"The fine is 2,000 VND per day, capped at the price of the book." (charter)
"Store the fines in a separate table so finance can query them." (finance officer)
"Loans must be retained for 5 years for audit and then deleted." (auditor)
"If the e-wallet does not answer within 10 seconds, the payment is cancelled and the reader is told to try later." (IT)
"The kiosks are the old Windows 8 touch screens we already own." (IT)
"Library users are students, lecturers and alumni; alumni may only read in the library." (director)

bang.giaiThich: A fine formula and who may waive a fine are policies (business rules); "should be able to pay" is a user goal; a table design is a solution idea; the timeout behaviour is functional; reusing old kiosks is a constraint. Retention periods required by audit are business rules that later produce data requirements.

mistakesJson.loi: Xếp công thức tính phạt là functional.
Xếp "lưu ở bảng riêng" là data requirement.

exercises.title: Classifying input 4 — split one paragraph into requirements
exercises.problemHtml:
The head of the student dormitory said in one breath:

"[1] We want fewer complaints about repairs — half as many by next year. [2] Students need to report a broken item from their phone at any time. [3] By regulation, electrical faults must be fixed within 24 hours. [4] When a report is created, the system sends it to the technician on duty for that building. [5] The technicians use cheap Android phones, Android 10. [6] A report has the room number, the item, a photo and a description of at most 500 characters. [7] Put the reports on a big map of the buildings. [8] It has to work even with the weak Wi-Fi in building C."

Classify each numbered part in BUCKETS.

Requirements

  • Values: Business requirement | User requirement | Business rule | Functional requirement | Quality attribute | External interface | Constraint | Data requirement | Solution idea
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Trưởng KTX nói một mạch (bản tiếng Anh, tám phần [1]–[8]). Phân loại từng phần trong BUCKETS.

Yêu cầu

  • Giá trị: Business requirement | User requirement | Business rule | Functional requirement | Quality attribute | External interface | Constraint | Data requirement | Solution idea

examplesJson.input: [1] We want fewer complaints about repairs — half as many by next year.
examplesJson.explanation: A business objective with a target and a deadline.|||Mục tiêu nghiệp vụ có chỉ tiêu và thời hạn.

hintsJson: Mỗi phần thuộc một nhóm khác nhau (trừ phần 1 đã cho sẵn).
Phần [8] là "hoạt động được dù mạng yếu" — một thuộc tính chất lượng.

solutionCodeJson.name: answer.js
solutionCodeJson.code:
// [8] is a quality attribute (robustness under a poor network) to be quantified later.
const BUCKETS = { 1: 'Business requirement', 2: 'User requirement', 3: 'Business rule', 4: 'Functional requirement', 5: 'Constraint', 6: 'Data requirement', 7: 'Solution idea', 8: 'Quality attribute' };

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: [1] business · [2] user · [3] business rule · [4] functional · [5] constraint · [6] data · [7] solution idea · [8] quality attribute. One paragraph, eight different kinds of requirement information — that is why notes must be classified before they go into the documents.

mistakesJson.loi: Xếp [7] (bản đồ) là functional — đó là ý tưởng giải pháp, cần hỏi nhu cầu thật (thấy nhanh chỗ nào đang hỏng).
Xếp [5] là external interface — điện thoại của kỹ thuật viên giới hạn nền tảng ⇒ constraint.
